_meta.purpose: Lines-per-book for the Homeric corpus. Mirrors nt_chapter_lengths.json: reject out-of-range citations (Od. 6.882 -> Odyssey book 6 has 331 lines -> divert). Without it the OCR-noise guard in locus._expand_bookline only checks book<=24 and line>=1, so any line number within a valid book passes, and ~0.5% of Homer weight (mostly Iliad lines mis-cued to the same-numbered Odyssey book, and OCR garbage) lands beyond the book's real end and stretches every line-heat row out to ~line 880.
_meta.numbering: OCT / standard vulgate line counts. Index = book - 1.
_meta.note: A citation whose (wrong) line happens to fall within the book's length is undetectable here; this table bounds the DETECTABLE contamination, which is the part that distorts the line map.
